cards.card_text: Into the treasury go 61,000 darics of gold, 5,000 minas of silver and 100 priestly garments.
cards.verse_text: According to their ability, they gave to the treasury for this work 61,000 darics of gold, 5,000 minas of silver, and 100 priestly garments.
cards.snippet: …gave to the treasury for this work 61,000 darics of gold, 5,000 minas of silver, and 100 priestly garments.

cards.card_text: Then He sets one standard for every measure and weight, right down to the shekel and the mina.
cards.verse_text: Twenty shekels plus twenty-five shekels plus fifteen shekels will equal one mina.
cards.snippet: Twenty shekels plus twenty-five shekels plus fifteen shekels will equal one mina.

cards.card_text: Before he goes, he hands ten of his servants ten minas, one each.
cards.verse_text: Beforehand, he called ten of his servants and gave them ten minas.
cards.snippet: Beforehand, he called ten of his servants and gave them ten minas.

cards.card_text: The first servant steps up, and his one mina has produced TEN more minas.
cards.verse_text: The first servant came forward and said, ‘Master, your mina has produced ten more minas.’
cards.snippet: The first servant came forward and said, ‘Master, your mina has produced ten more minas.’

cards.card_text: The second servant reports that his mina has made ten more minas, the same as the first servant's.
cards.verse_text: The second servant came and said, ‘Master, your mina has made five minas.’
cards.snippet: The second servant came and said, ‘Master, your mina has made five minas.’

cards.card_text: His mina has made five minas, and the master gives him authority over five cities.
cards.verse_text: The second servant came and said, ‘Master, your mina has made five minas.’ And to this one he said, ‘You shall have authority over five cities.’
cards.snippet: The second servant came and said, ‘Master, your mina has made five minas.’ And to this one he said, ‘You shall…

cards.card_text: Then another servant comes in: "Master, here is your mina, which I have laid away in a piece of cloth." That mina spent the whole time wrapped up and put away, and friend, after my years in the back of a junk drawer, I KNOW how that feels.
cards.verse_text: Then another servant came and said, ‘Master, here is your mina, which I have laid away in a piece of cloth.
cards.snippet: Then another servant came and said, ‘Master, here is your mina, which I have laid away in a piece of cloth.

cards.card_text: Then the master gives an order to those standing by: take the mina away from him.
cards.verse_text: Then he told those standing by, ‘Take the mina from him and give it to the one who has ten minas.’
cards.snippet: Then he told those standing by, ‘Take the mina from him and give it to the one who has ten minas.’
